senses.gloss:
ऽअह्न -अह्न, i. e. अहन् + अ, A substitute for अहन् in the latter part of some compound words, e. g. पराह्न and पराहन्, i. e. पर-, m. The afternoon.
 पूर्व-, and प्र-, m. The forenoon, Man. 2, 256.
 मध्य-, m. Noon, Lass. 73, 18.
 साय-, m. Evening.
अह्नाय अह्नाय, (properly dat. sing. of the preceding), adv. Soon, Ragh. 5, 71.

आह्निक आह्निक, i. e. अहन् + इक,
 I. adj. Daily, MBh. 3, 10772.
 II. n. A religious ceremony which must be performed every day, Rām. 1, 25, 2.
 --Comp.
